idea-plugin.name: CodeBuddy
idea-plugin.description: A tutor in your Mac's notch. Write #? question or #!teoria topic on its own line and press Enter: the question and the code around it go to the local CodeBuddy brain, and the answer shows up in the notch. When you stop typing in a Python file for 4 seconds, the code around the cursor goes to the brain too, which may peek out with one short hint from a local model. The plugin never edits your code, except for the "CodeBuddy: Clear Triggers" action.

action.description: Remove every #? and #!teoria line from this file
